name: Mahou Senshi Lemmtear Knights 2 - Another World
original_name: 魔法戦士レムティアナイツ2 Another World
source:
The world was supposed to be saved by the Mahou Senshi (Magical Warrior)... However, there was another possibility. In the world where the awakened Lemmtear Theta was defeated by the strongest demon Dirac, the Mahou Senshis scattered away and fell prey to the mobs. How did it all get to this? Another conclusion of the heroines that are struggling to save the world while falling into Dirac's trap has arrived.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015158.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
世界本来应该由魔法战士来拯救……然而，还有另一种可能。在觉醒的雷姆提尔·西塔被最强恶魔狄拉克击败的世界里，魔法战士们四散奔逃，沦为暴徒的猎物。这一切是怎么变成这样的？陷入狄拉克陷阱的同时努力拯救世界的女主角们的另一个结局已经到来。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015158.html]DLsite[/url]]
